what: Before a started daemon listens it syncs the profile history (`profile fsync`), and that one sync took 0.13 to 1.34 s across runs of the same binaries on one VM. The first request after a restart was 3.9, 3.9, 4.1 s on the base and 5.1, 5.2, 4.4 s on this lane's binary with requests of 3.38 and 3.48 s: the row moves by more than the change under test.
cost: three extra runs of each binary, and a restart row that still cannot be compared
cause: a sync of telemetry on the path to the first answer (restore.md already counts 0.72 s of it on the Mac)
workaround: read the request's own span (`request: read to reply`) and not the client's wall time
state: open: the profile history should not be synced before the daemon listens
